tours.name: Archive a Department
tours.description: Learn how to archive a department that no longer exists, so it disappears from the lists and the organisation chart but its history is kept.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to archive a department that no longer exists, so it disappears from the lists and the organisation chart but its history is kept.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Departments are managed in the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Departments are managed in the Employees app.

steps.title: Departments
steps.description: Every department is shown as a card with the number of employees in it.

description_i18n.en_US: Every department is shown as a card with the number of employees in it.

steps.title: Find the department
steps.content: Type the name of the department and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the department and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you open the right card. Only archive a department you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you open the right card. Only archive a department you no longer need.

steps.title: Card menu
steps.content: Click the three dots on the department card.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the three dots on the department card.

steps.description: The menu on the card opens the department's related lists and its settings.

description_i18n.en_US: The menu on the card opens the department's related lists and its settings.

steps.title: Configuration
steps.content: Click Configuration to open the department form.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Configuration to open the department form.

steps.description: The form is where the department can be archived.

description_i18n.en_US: The form is where the department can be archived.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to this department is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to this department is in this menu.

steps.title: Archive
steps.description: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

description_i18n.en_US: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

steps.description: Employees keep their department name in their history. Move them to another department first if they should still appear in a team.

description_i18n.en_US: Employees keep their department name in their history. Move them to another department first if they should still appear in a team.
